title: What is the biggest challenge in learning English?
cleaned_text: '' I think the biggest challenge in learning English is speaking naturally under pressure because sometimes I know the words but I I hesitate and lose confidence.''
recommendations: Build in intentional pauses to replace fillers/hesitations (you had 0 pauses, but ~18.5 fillers and ~18.5 hesitation sounds per 100 words). Practice “period pauses”: after each sentence, silently count “one-one-thousand” before continuing. In rehearsal, mark 3–5 pause spots in your notes (after key points or before a new idea). This gives your brain planning time so you don’t default to “um/uh/like.”

Raise your pace slightly for smoother flow (99.7 WPM is on the slow side and can make you feel less confident). Do 5 minutes of pacing drills: read a short paragraph aiming for 115–130 WPM, using a timer and a slash mark “/” where you’ll pause. Keep the pauses, but shorten the in-between words—think “steady and conversational,” not rushed.

Use a filler-replacement script and a reset technique. Pick one go-to replacement for thinking moments: a silent breath + a transition phrase like “Here’s the key point…” or “What this means is…”. When you catch a hesitation sound, do a quick reset: stop, inhale through the nose, then restart the sentence from the last clear phrase (don’t apologize). Track one metric per practice (e.g., reduce fillers from 5 to 3) to build confidence through visible wins.
